goal: Review and address process leakage, metacommentary, irrelevant context, hidden audience assumptions, genre confusion, unnecessary justification and unsupported reframing while preserving meaningful history and evidence.
baseline: old_skill = frozen pre-editorial natural-writing v3; not no-skill
version_policy: Same uncommitted initial release; expand its intentional 1.0.0 contract rather than add an artificial second version.

conditions.actors: Fresh fork_turns=none batch actor per arm; identical task order and prompts, own skill snapshot only; cases within a batch share context.
conditions.reviewers: Fresh blind reviewer independent of actors; root semantic audit and exact checks separate.
conditions.context: Source notes are supplied in test prompts, not an actual full coding-session history; realistic selection stress but limited ecological validity.
conditions.model: Inherited session model; exact build and sampling settings unavailable.
conditions.limits: One first attempt per arm per frozen task; purposeful retries after changes retained as development. No arbitrary campaign ceiling imposed.
conditions.authority: User authorized local tuning and iterative tests. Session subagents only; no external paid API, publishing, or automation.
conditions.accounting: Tokens, session charge and per-case generation latency unknown, not zero. No external paid-model dispatch.
conditions.resources: Synthetic files under campaign directory, canonical skill/catalog/changelog edits; task-specific temporary validator environment only.

source_review.status: Primary contents checked in preceding review; no empirical prevalence or causal claim adopted. Unsupported factual substitutions in conversation examples rejected.
